_purpose: Declares the ROLE of each LLM provider identity in AI-OS, so that a temporary arrangement
cannot quietly become the assumed target state. Read this before concluding anything about
This file is the governance record. The runtime reads the same roles through
groq_client.resolve_deepseek_host(); a test asserts the two agree, so they cannot drift.

deepseek_direct.note: The intended primary SUT provider. Keeps the historical 'deepseek' telemetry label so measurements stay comparable with the 32/38 and 38/38 baselines recorded under it.

deepseek_nvidia.hosts: NVIDIA NIM hosting a DeepSeek model
deepseek_nvidia.expires_when: DeepSeek Direct account is funded and passes a health smoke
deepseek_nvidia.note: NOT a migration and NOT the target state. Any benchmark produced while this host is active is TEMP_PROVIDER_CAPABILITY_SIGNAL, never a final canonical Capability baseline.
deepseek_nvidia.model_policy: EXPLICIT_REQUIRED. No default, and no NVIDIA_MODEL fallback. The bridge changes the HOST while preserving the logical model identity, so the operator must state the exact NIM model id for the intended DeepSeek model. Selecting this host without it is a ConfigError.
deepseek_nvidia.model_identity_intent: Match the canonical DeepSeek model as closely as the host offers. If NVIDIA NIM does not host an equivalent, that is a finding to report -- not grounds to substitute a different DeepSeek model, which would change provider and model at once.

groq.note: Router-tier fallback for the structured stages. Also the deliberately frozen judge provider, which is a separate concern from the SUT chain.

cerebras.note: Declared in the fallback chain; skipped while unconfigured.

openai_chat.note: Removed from the active fallback chain on 2026-08-10. A configured credential alone must never make it primary.

anthropic.note: Tier-2 slot, unconfigured in this deployment and therefore skipped.

rules: The host switch is explicit and operator-controlled. There is no automatic provider switch triggered by a billing or quota error.
Switching hosts changes endpoint, credential and model id only. Prompts, schema contracts, reasoning policy and business logic are identical across hosts.
Telemetry must always distinguish which host served a call: llm_deepseek_host, llm_provider_role and llm_canonical_target travel with every DeepSeek-tier response.
A final canonical Capability baseline may only be established on deepseek_direct.

The bridge model id is explicit-only: no default, no NVIDIA_MODEL fallback, and no substitution of the canonical model id. Changing host and model at the same time would make a bridge measurement uninterpretable.
